title: Race
desc: The relationship between two stepbrothers develops cracks when they fall in love with the same woman. As a result, the younger brother tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

title: The Power of 3 Jai Luv Kush
desc: Identical triplets get separated at a young age and follow different paths in life. Ill-treated as a child due to his stammering, the eldest seeks revenge on his brothers when they reunite as adults.

title: Vikramadithyan
desc: Two close friends face various hurdles as they navigate the complexities of life while striving to realise their shared dreams.

title: Encounter Shankar
desc: Post his transfer to a village, an encounter specialist sets out to stop a crime boss who wants to build a power plant in the region despite strong public opposition.

title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, an underdog and a failure, comes to know that his real father is a rich diamond merchant who has just passed away. When he goes to retrieve his wealth, he learns that a dog has inherited it.
